summary: DynaResource filed an 8-K on May 15, 2026, under Item 8.01 to disclose its Q1 2026 financial results via press release. The filing reports revenue of $18.0M, net income of $2.5M, and positive adjusted EBITDA of $6.0M for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine earnings release with no special situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring. The filing does not involve any change of control, tender offer, or strategic review. As a standard operational update, it does not trigger special-situation classification.
